q: Where can you go rafting on the Una river near Bihać?
a: Rafting near Bihać runs on several sections of the Una: Štrbački buk to Lohovo inside Una National Park, Kostela to Grmuša, and Grmuša to Bosanska Krupa downstream of the town. The sections differ in difficulty and length, so the right choice depends on your group's experience and the water level. Operators usually provide transport to the put-in and back.

q: What are the rafting sections on the Una and how do they differ?
a: The best-known section is Štrbački buk to Lohovo, about 15 km long with rapids and small waterfalls, and it is also the most demanding. Kostela to Grmuša is calmer and suits families and beginners, while Grmuša to Bosanska Krupa has moderate rapids. Below Bosanska Krupa the river is mostly calm and slow.

q: How long is the Štrbački buk to Lohovo rafting route?
a: The stretch from Štrbački buk to Lohovo is about 15 km and takes 3 to 4 hours, according to Una National Park. Some operators finish earlier at Loskun, skipping the calmer final part towards Lohovo. Because the section lies inside the park, you pay the Una National Park entrance fee on top of the rafting price.

q: How long does a rafting trip on the Una take?
a: The descent itself takes roughly 2 to 4 hours, depending on the section and water level. Once you add arriving at the base, changing, the safety briefing and transport to the start, plan for about half a day in total. On longer trips there is often a break along the river for swimming and a rest.

q: How difficult is rafting on the Una?
a: It depends on the section and the water level. Una National Park grades the Štrbački buk to Lohovo section from grade 3 to 5 at high water in April and May, and from grade 2 to 4 at medium water. The Kostela to Grmuša section is much calmer and a good choice for a first rafting trip.

q: Is rafting on the Una suitable for beginners?
a: Yes, complete beginners can raft the Una because every boat has a licensed skipper. Before setting off you are shown how to paddle and how to behave in the boat, and the skipper steers through the rapids. Beginners are usually advised to choose a calmer section or go at medium water levels.

q: What is the minimum age for rafting on the Una?
a: On calmer sections such as Kostela to Grmuša, operators usually take children from about 6 years old, depending on the water level. For the more demanding section from Štrbački buk, operators generally do not recommend it for children under 12. Mention your children's ages when booking, and the operator decides on the day whether the water is safe for them.

q: Do you need to be able to swim to go rafting?
a: On calmer sections swimming is generally not required, as everyone wears a life jacket and helmet. It is still better if participants can at least swim a little and stay calm in the water, especially on harder sections and at higher water levels. If you cannot swim, tell the operator before booking so they can recommend a suitable section.

q: What equipment is provided for rafting on the Una?
a: The operator provides the raft, paddle, life jacket and helmet, and often a dry bag for your belongings. When the water is colder, in spring or autumn, wetsuits are usually provided too. The life jacket and helmet are compulsory and must stay on for the whole descent.

q: What should I wear for rafting on the Una?
a: Wear swimwear or quick-drying sportswear, and footwear that stays firmly on your feet, such as strapped sandals or old trainers. Flip-flops are a bad idea because they come off easily in the water. Bring a towel, dry clothes to change into, sun cream and a cap.

q: When is the rafting season on the Una?
a: Rafting on the Una runs roughly from March or April to October, depending on the weather in a given year. The water is usually highest and the rapids strongest in April and May. In summer the water is lower, warmer and calmer, which makes it the best time for families and beginners.

q: How does the water level affect rafting on the Una?
a: At high water, usually in spring, the rapids are stronger, the river is faster and the descent more demanding. At medium and lower levels, in summer and early autumn, the ride is calmer and better suited to beginners and children. The operator assesses the river on the day and chooses the section accordingly.

q: How cold is the water on the Una when rafting?
a: The Una is a cold mountain river, and on the section from Štrbački buk the water is roughly 13 to 17 °C, according to Una National Park. It is colder in spring, which is why operators usually hand out wetsuits. In summer, a swim during the break is a pleasant way to cool down.

q: Is rafting on the Una safe?
a: Rafting on the Una is considered safe as long as the rules are followed: every boat is led by a licensed skipper, and life jackets and helmets must be worn at all times. You raft at your own risk, so it is important to follow the skipper's instructions from start to finish. Alcohol is strictly forbidden before and during rafting.

q: What are the rafting rules in Una National Park?
a: In Una National Park it is forbidden to drink alcohol, to endanger your own or others' safety, or to remove your helmet or life jacket. Everyone must follow the skipper's instructions, and the trip leader or skipper can exclude anyone who ignores the rules. The list of licensed rafting agencies is published on the park's official website, npuna.com.

q: Which Una rafting section is best for beginners and families?
a: The Kostela to Grmuša section is the one most often recommended for beginners and families, as it is calm, scenic and has spots for swimming. The descent takes about two and a half hours of easy paddling. Children can usually join from about 6 years old, depending on the water level and the operator's judgement.

q: Which Una rafting section is best for experienced rafters?
a: More experienced rafters usually choose Štrbački buk to Lohovo, especially in spring at higher water, when the rapids and waterfalls are at their strongest. The first part of this section is fast and unpredictable, with many small and larger drops, rapids and whirlpools. The Grmuša to Bosanska Krupa section also has moderate rapids.

q: Where is Una Olympic Rafting located?

q: Is lunch included with rafting on the Una?
a: That depends on the operator and the package you choose. Una Olympic Rafting has a riverside restaurant at its base, so lunch after the descent can often be arranged with the trip. Mention in your enquiry whether you want lunch so you get an accurate quote.

q: Can large groups go rafting on the Una?
a: Yes, rafting is a popular choice for larger groups, friends, companies and stag or hen parties. Every boat is led by a licensed skipper, and a larger group is split across several boats depending on their size. For big groups it is worth booking ahead, especially in summer and at weekends, and giving the exact number of people.

q: Is rafting on the Una good for team building?
a: Rafting on the Una is often chosen for team building because it requires paddling together and communicating in the boat, with no previous experience needed. The descent is usually followed by lunch by the river and time together. For groups staying several days, we can offer houses on the Una in Lohovo, Pritoka or Grmuša.

q: What should I bring on a rafting trip?
a: Bring swimwear, a towel, dry clothes and shoes to change into, sun cream and a cap. Keep your phone and documents in a dry bag or leave them in the car, as everything gets wet in the boat. Secure glasses with a strap and leave jewellery at your accommodation.

q: Can I take my phone rafting?
a: You can, but only in a waterproof pouch or case, because everything gets wet during the descent and the raft can capsize. Some operators provide dry bags or take photos during the trip. If you have no protection for it, it is safer to leave your phone at the base or in the car.

q: What happens if I fall out of the raft?
a: If you fall in, your life jacket keeps you afloat, and before setting off the skipper explains how to position yourself in the water and how you will be pulled back into the boat. Usually you lie on your back with your feet pointing downstream and follow instructions. Stay calm, as the boat and skipper are close by.

q: Can you go rafting on the Una when it rains?
a: Yes, you get wet rafting anyway, so rain usually makes little difference. The operator may still cancel or change the section if heavy rain suddenly raises the water level or there is a thunderstorm. You will be told on the day or the day before.

q: Do I need to book rafting on the Una in advance?
a: Yes, it is best to book ahead, especially in July and August and at weekends, when it is busiest. When booking, give the number of people, the children's ages and your preferred section. If you are staying with us, we can arrange a slot with Una Olympic Rafting together with your booking.

q: How far is Grmuša from Bihać?
a: Grmuša is about 20 km north-east of central Bihać, along the Una towards Bosanska Krupa. It is roughly a 20 to 25-minute drive from town. We have riverside houses in Grmuša, so the Una Olympic Rafting base is practically on your doorstep.

q: What is the Una Regatta?
a: The Una Regatta (Una regata) is a traditional international tourist regatta, a descent of the Una by boat over several days with a cultural and entertainment programme. It takes place in summer, usually in July, and the 52nd edition was held in 2026. Check the organisers' official announcements for next year's dates and route.

q: Can you go rafting on the Una in spring?
a: Yes, and spring, especially April and May, brings the highest water and strongest rapids on the Una. That makes it more exciting for those looking for a thrill, but the water is colder, so wetsuits are usually provided. For small children and beginners, summer is the better choice.

q: Can you go rafting on the Una in October?
a: Rafting on the Una usually runs until October, depending on the weather and water level in a given year. October is quieter, but the water and air are colder, so wetsuits are standard. Check with the operator, as the season can end earlier.

q: Can older people go rafting on the Una?
a: Yes, if they are in generally good health and mobile, since paddling on calmer sections is easy and the skipper steers the boat. For older guests the Kostela to Grmuša section at summer water levels is usually recommended. Tell the operator about any health issues, such as heart or back problems, before setting off.

q: Is rafting safe during pregnancy?
a: Rafting is generally not recommended during pregnancy because of possible knocks, falling into cold water and sudden movements in the rapids. If your group is going rafting, you could take a gentle walk along the river or view Štrbački buk from the viewpoints instead. It is best to ask your doctor for advice.

q: Is the Štrbački buk rafting section inside Una National Park?
a: Yes, the Štrbački buk to Lohovo section lies within Una National Park, so you pay the park entrance fee on top of the rafting price. Only licensed rafting agencies and skippers may operate in the park. Check the list of agencies and current ticket prices on the park's official website, npuna.com.

q: What does a typical rafting day on the Una look like?
a: The day usually starts with arriving at the base, changing and getting your equipment, followed by a safety briefing. You are then driven to the start for a descent of a few hours, with breaks for swimming. After the finish you return to the base to change, often followed by lunch together by the river.

q: Can you swim during a rafting trip on the Una?
a: Yes, on most sections the skipper stops at a calmer stretch or by the bank where you can swim. Some operators also allow jumps from low rocks, but only at spots the skipper approves. The Una is cold, so swims are short but refreshing.

q: Can we go rafting on the Una as a day trip?
a: Yes, rafting fits easily into a day trip, as the whole programme takes about half a day. Many guests still stay at least one night so they can visit Štrbački buk or relax by the river afterwards. You can book accommodation on the Una or in Bihać at apartmanibihac.com.
